talia: Heads-up: int8 bringup shows a small but consistent drop in factuality on news-qa. Need a focused promptset curation to rule out dataset leakage vs quant-induced hallucination. Can someone own a 24h triage?

ben: I can take lead on dataset triage. Plan: 1) run stratified sampling by source and answer length, 2) fingerprint-compare against training corpora to catch leakage, 3) assemble a 500-item golden for bench. ETA end of day.

yuri: For quant bench: the signal shows answer divergence mostly when references include structured lists or citations. Recommend we add 150 list-style prompts to the golden and label failure modes (missing_fact, wrong_source, fabricated_citation).

labelops: Current capacity: 5 contractors + 2 internal reviewers. Queue: 2.2k unassigned. Per-item: short 40s, list-style 180s. We can accept a prioritized 500 microgold batch and set review rate to 10% for QA.

talia: Ben, please include a de-dupe pass before labeling: two steps — token-hash dedupe then semantic embed dedupe (`embed-dedup --model embed-v2 --thresh 0.86`). Also mark any multiref items (multi_ref=true) so label UI shows all refs.

ben: Will run `python tools/dedupe_pipeline.py --steps hash,embed --embed-thresh 0.86 --out microgold_int8_bias_2026-03-23.ndjson` and push to /shared/curation/qbench/microgold/int8-bias.

yuri: Add to bench README a small reproduction: `bench/compare.py --candidates int8-opt --baseline fp16-opt --prompts microgold_int8_bias_2026-03-23 --metrics exact_match,fact_precision,fabrication_rate` — flag if fabrication_rate > baseline + 0.015.

curation-bot: Auto-note: microgold prepped by ben at /shared/curation/qbench/microgold/int8-bias/microgold_int8_bias_2026-03-23.ndjson (size 502).

labelops: Allocating contractors: 3 to list-style batch (180s avg), 2 to short. Expect first labeled tranche (~120 items) in ~4h. QA reviewers scheduled for next day.

talia: Also ask bench to instrument `citation_confidence` in the compare output so we can separate wrong_source vs low-confidence answers. bench-bot can you add that to the compare pipeline for this run?

bench-bot: Scheduled ad-hoc compare after first labeled batch completes. Will include metrics: exact_match, fact_precision, fabrication_rate, citation_confidence. Notifying infra to pin canary traffic to 5% for the run.

ben: One more: please avoid including prompts where gold answer token length >1k until we confirm kv-cache integrity in runtime. I'll filter those out in the pipeline.

talia: Thanks y'all. We'll reconvene after the first compare and decide whether this is a quant artifact or dataset issue. :mag:
